# <span id="aanchor321"></span> Transaction Queue

This feature requires the **Online Transaction Processing** module.

The Transaction Queue service is an alternative to file imports and can be used to import data into FLOWCAL on a near real-time basis.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

An external SCADA system could create data entries within the Transaction Queue tables where the Transaction Queue service would read unprocessed entries. The service would then proceed through the list, performing validations and calculations, and storing the resulting information in FLOWCAL. Processed entries are marked as successfully or unsuccessfully processed; they are not deleted.

</div>

You can use the Transaction Queue screen to see meters, tickets, or source analyses that have not been processed or have failed. You can also force a re-queue of transaction data for meters, locations, source analyses, either individually or in a location or list. You can also force the re-queue of tickets in a location by location. The data can be re-queued for all of time or within a specified date range.

Additional Transaction Queue options can be configured from the [Service Configuration](Service%20Configuration.md) screen.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Transaction Queue screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manger**
2.  Select **Transaction Queue** within the **Services** group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 575;height: 372;" />

The **Queue** button is only enabled if you select the **Failed Data** tab.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Transaction Queue Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

#### Tabs

The following tabs are available in the Transaction Queue screen:

- **Data Requeue** - Re-queue meters, tickets (by location), or sources using a datetime range or for all data (all of time).
- **Unprocessed Data** - View records waiting to be processed by the Transaction Queue service.
- **Failed Data** - View records that have been processed by the Transaction Queue service and failed.
- **Processed Data** - View records that have been processed successfully by the Transaction Queue service.

#### Columns

The following columns are available in the Transaction Queue screen:

- **Source ID** - Displays the meter number, location number for tickets, or source number.
- **Transaction Type** - Displays the type of record to be processed.
  | Type                                        | Code |
  |---------------------------------------------|:----:|
  | Meter Event                                 |  1   |
  | Meter Alarm                                 |  2   |
  | Meter Periodic                              |  3   |
  | Meter Configuration                         |  4   |
  | Quality Source Periodic                     |  5   |
  | Standalone Sample Analysis (Liquid Only)    |  8   |
  | Ultrasonic Periodic (Gas Only)              |  10  |
  | Meter Batch (Liquid Only)                   |  11  |
  | Meter Alternate Periodic (Liquid Only)      |  12  |
  | Ticket - Meter (Liquid Only)                |  14  |
  | Ticket - Tank Gauge/Inventory (Liquid Only) |  15  |
  | Ticket - Tank Run (Liquid Only)             |  16  |
  | Ticket - Scale (Liquid Only)                |  17  |
  | Ticket - Rail Car (Liquid Only)             |  18  |
- **From** - The start time for which the record is effective.
- **To** - The end time for which the record is effective.
- **Unavailable Code** - Status of the entry. Entry is created with a code of 0 upon insert, indicating that the record has not been processed. The status code will change when the entry has been processed.
  | Status                            | Code |
  |-----------------------------------|:----:|
  | Unprocessed                       |  0   |
  | Processed successfully            | 1-9  |
  | Unable to save meter data         |  10  |
  | Meter calculation method mismatch |  94  |
  | Meter out of service              |  95  |
  | Time frame is closed              |  96  |
  | Unable to save source data        |  97  |
  | Meter or source does not exist    |  98  |
  | Invalid timestamp                 |  99  |
- **Min Read Date** - The minimum read date is when the data was processed by the Transaction Queue service.
- **Max Read Date** - The maximum read date is when the data was processed by the Transaction Queue service.
- **Min Write Date** - Minimum insertion dates that reflect when the data was written to the Transaction Queue tables.
- **Max Write Date** - Maximum insertion dates that reflect when the data was written to the Transaction Queue tables.

</div>
